cases.name: Sandra Mary Bass Brown
cases.narrative:
On 8/10/1978, a man mowing weeds found her body in a ditch along Illinois Route 78, about a mile north of Kewanee, IL. Her throat had been slit so radically that she was almost decapitated.

She was attacked while walking her dog at about 1:00 am.
